words.cue: Flat hand by your forehead — wave side to side
Fist — nod your wrist up and down, twice
Index + middle snap down onto your thumb
Flat hand from your chin — push forward
Both fists — only the top hand cranks
Claw at your mouth — flick out and down, fast
Both fists — shiver side to side
Fist on your flat palm — lift both hands
